CustomField.description: Minimum gap between stalled-job watchdog runs started from job submission. Blank, zero, or negative uses the framework default of 15 minutes; values from 1 to 4 are raised to 5. The worst-case delay before a stalled job is closed is roughly Stalled_Job_Minutes__c plus this interval.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Minutes between stalled-job watchdog runs. Blank uses 15; the minimum is 5.
CustomField.label: Watchdog Interval (min)
